name: landmarkmap_ipcl_dataset
title: LandMark: Indigenous Peoples' and Community Lands
description: Locations of Indigenous Peoples' and local community lands and territories from LandMark. Measures percent overlap with the unit of analysis.
details: Based on both polygons and points (points buffered to small polygons). The underlying Indigenous and community land boundaries are drawn from LandMark and its contributing providers and represent a first reference, not a definitive or verified source of truth on land tenure. The absence of a boundary does not indicate the absence of Indigenous or community land, and coverage is incomplete and unevenly sourced across regions. Any use that could affect these lands or communities requires independent verification (e.g., ground-truthing) rather than reliance on these boundaries alone. See the LandMark website for more information on the data, its sources, and appropriate use: https://landmarkmap.org/.
citation: LandMark: The Global Platform of Indigenous and Community Lands. https://landmarkmap.org/

categories: Held or used under customary tenure
Held or used with formal land claim submitted

processing_options.description: Filter features by user-selected criteria and compute percent overlap with the unit of analysis.

variable_description: percent overlap with LandMark community/Indigenous land points (buffered)
